source.source_locator: 教則 第6章 6.2「気象の重要性及び情報源」(3)8)冬の天気

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 西高東低の冬型ではシベリア高気圧からの季節風が吹き、日本海側に雪をもたらす。
evidence.tested_misconception: 西高東低では太平洋高気圧が支配的となり、日本海側の雪は生じにくい。
evidence.reasoning_path: winter pressure pattern -> Siberian-high monsoon flow -> Sea-of-Japan snow risk

collision.note: Tier A。既存気象問は低気圧・前線・一般情報収集を扱うが、日本の冬型気圧配置と日本海側降雪の対応は未出。

independent_review.rationale: The west-high/east-low winter pattern and Sea-of-Japan snowfall consequence are source-defined and absent from the canonical bank.

The five accepted Tier B candidates C014, C017, C018, C019 and C020 retain material source-defined distinctions in temporal start-gate, GNSS failure, battery failure, explicit exception boundary and forced-landing lifecycle state. No accepted B11 candidate relies on a subsection explicitly marked 〔一等〕. The 20-candidate ceiling is not a quota. Two candidates are deliberately dropped without backfill.
